SELECT CAST(fish_date_doy/30 AS INT) AS bucket, cls, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers),3) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5') AND fish_date_season=2
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT avail_doy, value FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 6
